title: Card - Package
description: Package/pricing-tier card shell with a larger corner radius and no rest-state shadow (unlike Card - Category). Used by the homepage "Where to fit" package row. The featured tier's brand border and elevated shadow are a per-instance rest-state override, not a shared style, so they stay as an inline block style on that one card rather than in this JSON (a shared style slug can't express a value that differs for a single instance).
